project-portfolio-capacity.title: Weekly workload and capacity
project-portfolio-capacity.description: Compare scheduled work with each person’s availability, then open the tasks behind a result.
project-portfolio-capacity.invalid_week: Select This week to reset to a valid Monday.
project-portfolio-capacity.invalid_snaps: The capacity response could not be verified for the selected week.
project-portfolio-capacity.scope_limit: There are too many qualifying tasks to calculate this week completely. Select another week.
project-portfolio-capacity.empty_hint: No qualifying tasks with a human assignee and complete planned dates overlap this week.
project-portfolio-capacity.filter_empty_: Choose another capacity category to review this week.
project-portfolio-capacity.scope_note: Includes open tasks with complete dates in projects you can access. Estimates are distributed over the full task interval using the organization work calendar. These are planned hours.
project-portfolio-capacity.ask_calendar_: An organization admin can check this calendar.
